# Introduction

This fixture validates header-aware chunking for a production RAG assistant. The introduction stays below CHUNK_SIZE so the entire section should index as one chunk. # Embeddings

Embedding generation follows chunking during document ingest. Each chunk is encoded by a provider such as OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and stored with metadata. Batch APIs reduce cost when files produce many segments. When this section exceeds CHUNK_SIZE, header-aware chunking repeats the H1 title in every sub-chunk. Engineers compare cosine distances across strategies using fixed fixtures to detect regressions. Embedding model upgrades require full reindex because vector geometry changes with model weights. Latency budgets should account for parse, chunk, embed, and upsert phases on the upload path. # Retrieval

Retrieval embeds the user question, searches the vector store with top_k limits, and assembles context. SimilarityRetriever ranks chunks by distance and passes them to ContextBuilder for numbered formatting. Multi-document chat filters by attached document_ids but shares one global top_k pool across files. RAG_DEBUG logs retrieved previews, chunk indices, and prompt token estimates for engineers. Tune top_k against chunk token counts to balance recall with model context limits. Header repetition preserves section identity when large markdown sections split during indexing. Grounded prompts instruct the LLM to answer only from supplied context and refuse when evidence is missing. Hybrid retrieval combining keyword and vector signals remains a common upgrade path for production systems Production teams validate chunk boundaries with fixture files, measure indexed_chunk_count at upload time, and compare retrieval quality across strategies before promoting a configuration to production serving paths. # Conclusion

This conclusion summarizes expected chunk counts for CHUNK_SIZE fifteen hundred: one chunk for introduction, two for embeddings, two for retrieval, and one for conclusion. Re-upload after changing strategies because chunking happens at ingest, not during chat.
